reviews.title: 複雑すぎ
reviews.text:
普通のスケジュール帳のように「書いた文字や時間をそのまま表示したいだけ」なのに、文字から時間が勝手に認識・消去されたり、勝手に「タイトルなし」になったりと余計な自動変換が多くて非常にストレスを感じます。
機能が複雑すぎて直感的に使えません。テキストを勝手に自動処理しないシンプルな入力・表示モード（または自動変換のオフ機能）を設けてほしいです。

reviews.title: 프리미엄 구매
reviews.text:
제가 이 앱을 사용하려는데 프리미엄으로 구매하면 음력으로 반복기능이 있고 내용 보내기 등이 가능하다 하여 오늘 연간 프리미엄 구매했는데,  내용 보내기는 보내도 확장자가 뭔지 모르겠고 전혀 열리지가 않고, 음력으로 반복 기능 설정도 안되네요.. 당일 구매 후 한시간 뒤에 바로 구매 취소했는데 취소도 안되구요.. 
그럼 음력 반복 기능이든 내용 보내기 기능 어찌 사용할 수 있는지 알려주세요

reviews.title: Limited Configurability
reviews.text:
Update: 5 Mar 2026: Significant limitation: Location setting doesn't access Contacts and not all valid addresses recognised by whatever source the app uses. Result you can have an event for which you can't set the location. Other calendar apps can also use addresses from Contacts which then shop correctly on map displays.

Update: 25 Jan 2026: Tried again but too many annoying UI weirdness eg in day detail pop-up in month view all day (untimed) reminders are assigned the time they were last edited - they are without time of day so why display them with one ?

Some aspects very configurable but others very missing eg you cannot disable the totally useless “Weather” functionality despite this representing a privacy weakness and being totally useless. You can’t change the item spacing between list items (just the line spacing within items).

Seems it’s what the developer wants rather than what a broad user-base wants. So tried and not switched to - there are better offerings that consider what users want.

reviews.title: Critical Bug: Japanese Era (Gengo) calculation error in Task Date Picker
reviews.text:
I love the concept of managing events and tasks together, but there is a critical bug in the task date picker that makes it unusable. It seems like the app is incorrectly calculating the Japanese Era (Gengo).
[Issue Details]
1. Initial state: When I open the "Add Task" screen and tap the date button, the year defaults to "Hakuchi Year 1" (白雉1年), which is the year 650 AD. I have to scroll through over 1,300 years to reach the current year (Reiwa 8 / 2026).
2. After saving: Even after I manually scroll and select the correct date, once I finish editing, the year automatically changes to "Taika Year 636" (大化636年).
It appears there is a major conflict between the Western calendar (Gregorian) and the Japanese Imperial calendar settings in your date picker logic.
[Environment]
• Device: iPhone 17
• OS: iOS 26
• Steps to Reproduce: Simply open the task creation screen and try to set a date.
This app has great potential, but this bug is a deal-breaker. I would love to give it 5 stars once this "time-travel" bug is fixed!
